name: Salvador
blurb: Conversation about Salvador is up 180% on its six-month baseline, driven by travellers describing it as a calmer alternative to nearby hotspots. Most posts mention beaches, value and the shoulder season.

positive: Easy to get around without a car
Quieter than the better-known spots nearby

quotes.text: Prices have crept up but it is still cheaper than the mainland.
Much quieter than I expected — barely anyone on the beach at sunset.
Getting harder to find a decent room under budget this year.
